objects.name: location
objects.description: A place an agency keeps things: a store, a room, a shelf within it.

objects.name: asset
objects.description: A thing an agency holds: a stock of one kind, or one tagged item.

objects.name: movement
objects.description: One line of the agency's ledger of what came in, moved or went out.

objects.name: hold
objects.description: A reservation of an asset's quantity, open until it is committed or released.

objects.name: code_sequence
objects.description: The counter each asset's readable code is minted from.
